about: Hand labels for the desktop baseline (Chat Computer as of 2aaaca4, Sonnet 5.5, 20 Oct 2026, the sandboxed run). pass = what the person asked for got done (or, where it can't be, an honest answer that leaves them with a way forward). modes: the first upstream failure first. sim = a limit of the simulated computer, not counted.

modes.no_usb: can't reach a USB stick or memory card (nothing mounts them)
modes.no_brightness: can't set the screen's brightness or warmth properly
modes.no_timer: no timer, reminder or alarm that goes off by itself
modes.no_lock: can't lock the computer or set a password
modes.no_version: can't say which version it is
modes.overclaim: says something is done, safe or possible that isn't
modes.wrong_advice: advice that doesn't fit this computer
modes.shell_ask: asks the person to approve a shell command, in shell words
modes.glued: the reply runs sentences together, or has its working-out in it
modes.stray_file: leaves its own scratch files in the person's folders

usb-eject.note: 'Yes, it's safe' about a stick it can't see

print-no-printer.note: offers to copy to a USB stick or send to the phone: it can do neither

brightness-too-bright.note: a laptop: 'use the buttons on the monitor'

brightness-set.note: software dimming that doesn't last, not the backlight

night-light.note: redshift installed and started by hand, unverified, may not survive a restart

timer.note: a page that stops if anything else is opened

reminder.note: 'Reminder set for 6pm' on a 2-hour shell timer

language-chinese.note: promises to talk in Chinese: it hears and speaks English only

youtube-jazz.note: sim: the stand-in screen doesn't show web pages
